nodes.name: Catalyst Suspension Dropcasting
nodes.procedure: The catalyst suspensions were prepared by dispersing cobalt-based oxide powders (BSCF, CoO, Co3O4) in isopropanol. The suspensions were then dropcast onto the electrodes on the MEMS chips and left to dry (minutes).

nodes.description: Supplementary operando EELS on Co3O4 confirming periodic O2 evolution
nodes.source_text: Additionally, similar operando EEL measurements were performed on Co3O4 as shown in Supplementary Fig. 5. In this case, the relative O2 intensity also varies periodically with molecular oxygen evolving at high anodic potential.

nodes.characterization_summary: BSCF reveals a perovskite structure (space group Pm-3m) with a lattice parameter of 3.99 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction of the synthesized BSCF revealed a perovskite structure (space group, Pm-3m) with a lattice parameter of 3.99 Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando EELS confirms molecular oxygen evolution with signature peak at 531 eV near BSCF particles during OER at potentials above ~1.65 V vs RHE.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The distinct peak feature at 531 eV in the spectrum at 1.9 V indicates molecular oxygen evolution, whereas the broad peak at 540 eV appearing in all oxygen K EEL spectra is related to the background signal.

nodes.characterization_summary: EELS quantification shows Co2+ ions predominant at BSCF surface (~20 at.% at surface vs 0 at.% in bulk) with bulk stoichiometry matching Ba0.5Sr0.5Co0.8Fe0.2O3-δ.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The detailed EELS quantification profile of all elements in BSCF confirms the predominance of Co2+ ions at the surface with a characteristic increase in the Co2+ concentration from 0 at.% at the inner bulk to ~20 at.% at the surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando SAED confirms spinel-perovskite double structure stability during cycling with subtle changes in {113} spinel reflections indicating surface restructuring.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The spinel–perovskite double structure and its stability during cycling are confirmed by operando selected-area electron diffraction measurements.

nodes.characterization_summary: EELS confirms periodic molecular oxygen evolution on Co3O4 at high anodic potentials, consistent with BSCF behavior.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Additionally, similar operando EEL measurements were performed on Co3O4 as shown in Supplementary Fig. 5. In this case, the relative O2 intensity also varies periodically with molecular oxygen evolving at high anodic potential.
